itemUsage.zh: 拉特兰公证所高级特派员菲亚梅塔，只要定下目标，就一定会坚持到底。

itemDesc.en: Don't ask her about her codename, lest she make the time to take you out.

description.en:
Operator Fiammetta has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for inflicting physical casualties on multitudes of enemies.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Sniper Operator during field operations to exercise Artilleryman responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员菲亚梅塔擅长对复数敌人造成物理杀伤
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为狙击干员，行使炮手职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en:
It was a beautifully sunny afternoon years past, when the old man pushed a box before the still-young Liberi girl.
She hadn't even had time to wipe the soot off her face. She'd never had the finest control over firearms, though the Sankta her age used guns as naturally as their own limbs.
'Fia. I'm not going to say 'it's just a racial gulf' or whatever to try to comfort you, and I'm not going to proclaim that wielding guns is a Sankta-exclusive glory, like SOME cardinals. Practice will yield results, and you've as good as brushed shoulders with those results, even if it's not gone how you'd want.'
'But there's still a different way, or maybe you could say a different TOOL that could help you move forward. This box holds something one of my mechanics tutors left to me. He's not coming back to Laterano, ever. He violated the law.'
'But, child, law is not our everything. Now don't look at me like that—yes, you might go 'big whoop,' but nobody would say our everything ends at food and water either, right? They're just things we're forced to rely on to survive. There's always something that transcends the law, sits beyond it, and everyone has a different idea of what it is. Some call it righteousness, some call it sensibility, and some call it a vague hope.'
'Don't panic, and don't worry. There will be times when wanting to do something will make you unstoppable.'
......
The Liberi is no longer a girl; she's been more places than can be imagined, and seen more sights than can be believed, but afternoons in Laterano will never change. The sun is as fine and beautiful as ever.
These two weapons have been by her side for longer than can be described; they have ensured her safety through danger, and mercilessly shot down the absurd aspirations of others.
She carefully cleans the grime from her old friends, oils them, inspects the pressure in every last piece of ammo, and affirms again and again their ordering by type. She'll soon face her pursuer, her enemy of eight years, and there's no such thing as being overly prepared.
There is always something that transcends the law.
There's no vengeance in her heart, and no pity either. Only this: what must be settled will be settled, and those who must bear the cost will pay the price. She understands—this is an obsession, nothing more.
She slots the final shell into her magazine.
description.zh:
那是多年前的一个下午，阳光正好，老者把一个箱子推到了尚显稚嫩的黎博利女孩面前。
女孩脸上的烟尘还没来得及拭去，她始终无法顺利操纵铳械，明明同龄的萨科塔用起铳来自然得仿佛那是他们的手脚一般。
“小菲，我不会以这是种族造就的鸿沟这种理由安慰你，也不会像某些主教一样声称持铳是独属于萨科塔的荣光。练习终会有结果，你已经几乎触及了那份结果，不管它是不是遂了你的愿。”
“但仍有另外一条路，或者说是另外一种助你前行的工具。这箱子里的东西是我的一位机械师老友留下的。他已经无法再返回拉特兰，他违背了律法。”
“但是，孩子，律法不是我们的一切。别摆出那副大惊小怪的表情，不会有人说食物和水是我们的一切，对吧？我们只是不得不靠它们生存。总有东西超脱于律法之外，每个人对它的称呼和定义都不尽相同，有人说它是公义，有人说它是情感，有人说它是渺茫的希望。”
“别着急，也别担心，有的时候，你想做一件事，于是你便不可阻挡。”
……
黎博利已经不再是女孩，她去过了很多地方，见识过很多景色，但拉特兰的下午永远不会改变，阳光总是正好。
这两把武器已经陪伴了她很长时间，它们曾在危难中保护她的安全，也无情击坠过别人的奢望。
她仔细地给老朋友们除尘，上油，检查过每一枚弹药的气压，一再确认弹种的顺序，她将面对追缉八年的仇敌，任何准备都并不过分。
总有东西超脱于律法之外。
她的心中并无仇恨，也无怜悯，只是需被清算之事当获得清算，需承担代价之人当付出代价。她明白，这不过是一份执念。
她将最后一枚弹药填入弹仓。

description.en: 'Relax for once, Fiammetta. Look on the bright side... next time, we can report to Lemuen about our work.' Velliv's poring closely over the papers, but tosses the remark out anyway, like she can read her mind. Fiammetta sighs—this is what she hates about Velliv. The Sankta get in on each other's emotions thanks to their empathy, and she's no Sankta, but she's never felt like Velliv couldn't see straight through her anyway. Velliv abruptly lifts her head, as if some thought has struck, and looks at her. 'Speaking of which, Fiammetta, now's your chance.' 'What?' 'At independence.' '......' 'The team you and Mostima had going was a real exception, organizationally speaking—basically a custom set-up just for you two, not much flexibility. But now that Lemuen's joining, we've gotta shake up how it's structured. Perfect opportunity.' Velliv interlaces her fingers, props her chin up, and throws her a sunny grin. 'Who's saying this? Her? Lemuen? His Holiness? Or is it just you?' 'I'm not the type to stick my neck out. But it's not something I haven't thought about, you know.' She stoops down to pull a document out from the cupboard by her foot, which Fiammetta knows at a glance is the file on Andoain. 'After the incident at the Summit of Nations, they upped the risk level on Andoain a notch. If there was any hunter out there willing to devote her heart and soul to catching him, I'd sleep better at night for it.' 'Sometimes, I wish other Laterans would care for Laterano as much as you do.' It's not a lie. Even on the work front, Fiammetta considers Velliv an admirable example. 'So, what do you say?' 'I refuse.' 'Why? There's way more efficient ways to capture Andoain than working alongside Mostima, you know that.' 'It's because Mostima's worse.' 'Worse as in... Andoain's always gonna be there, but Mostima's the woman who might just vanish without a trace one day?' 'No. I haven't heard her actually speak her mind even once since His Holiness gave her her mission. I don't care if it feels like I'm the only idiot still clinging to the whole Andoain thing, and I don't blame her or Lemuen for having other ideas. But,' and she speaks that 'but' like she tore it off and spat it out, 'whatever she saw in that staff, whatever she's thinking, whatever the hell it is Lemuen forgives or pardons Andoain for—she can tell me, Lemuen can tell me, but they have to tell me something. They have to tell me everything... they owe me that much.' 'And what if they never ever tell you?' 'I can wait. As long as I'm their friend, as long as they're my friends.' 'I see. Well... it's looking to be a real long road, then.' 'Way ahead of you.'
description.zh:
“别总是这么紧张嘛，菲亚梅塔。往好了想，下一次，你们的工作内容就可以向蕾缪安汇报了。”
薇尔丽芙低着头批阅着文件，却仿佛猜到她在想什么一般开口。菲亚梅塔叹了口气，她就是讨厌薇尔丽芙这一点。萨科塔们可以通过共感了解同胞的情绪，她不是萨科塔，却总是感觉自己被薇尔丽芙看透了。
薇尔丽芙忽然像是想起了什么一样抬起头，看着她。
“说起来，菲亚梅塔，你现在有一个机会。”
“什么？”
“独立的机会。”
“……”
“你和莫斯提马的小队在编制上很特殊，几乎是为你们两个特别设立的，变动起来有些麻烦，而现在，因为蕾缪安的加入，编制上需要进行调整，正好是个机会。”
薇尔丽芙十指交叉，撑住自己的下巴，笑眯眯地看着她。
“这是谁的意思？她的？蕾缪安的？还是教宗阁下的，或者是你的？”
“我可不想给自己找不自在。不过，关于这一点，我也不是完全没有想法。”她顿了顿，从手边的柜子里抽出一份文件，菲亚梅塔扫一眼就知道，是安多恩的情报。“在万国峰会那件事后，安多恩的危险性进一步提高了，如果有一个能够全心全意追捕他的猎手，我会安心一些。”
“有的时候，我倒是希望其他拉特兰人也能像你一样关心拉特兰。”这句话倒不是假话，在工作层面，菲亚梅塔认为薇尔丽芙是值得敬佩的。
“那么，你的回答呢？”
“我拒绝。”
“为什么？你应该知道，和莫斯提马一起行动，实际上并不是最有效率的追捕安多恩的方式。”
“因为莫斯提马更麻烦。”
“你的意思是说……安多恩永远都在那，但是，莫斯提马才是有一天会突然消失的那个人？”
“不，从她接受教宗阁下的命令以来，我从来没有听她说过，她究竟是怎么想的。我不在乎好像只有我一个人像个傻子一样咬着安多恩不放，我不怪她和蕾缪安有其他想法。但是，”她把这个“但是”咬得很重，“无论她在那根杖里看到了什么，又在想什么，无论蕾缪安又原谅了安多恩的什么——她也好，蕾缪安也好，都必须亲口告诉我，这是她们欠我的。”
“要是她们永远都不告诉你呢？”
“我等得起。只要我还是她们的朋友，只要她们还是我的朋友。”
“原来如此。看来，这会是一场漫长的旅途。”
“我早就在路上了。”
